subject: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request
messages:
From: Dr. Leila Ahmad <l.ahmad@studyhub.org>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding last week — the StudyHub pilot is live and students have already started running questionnaires. We ran into an unexpected burst of token usage this morning when a nested prompt was used for a large annotation batch. Our remaining trial allowance will not cover the next two weeks of processing for the current cohort.

Would Redwood be able to approve a short-term compute supplement (we estimate ~30k tokens / equivalent) and a two-week extension of the trial window? This is a small, time-bound research project: non-profit, IRB-approved, and explicitly educational. I attached our IRB consent excerpt and a short pilot-impact summary so you can see the workload profile.

If helpful: the workload is mostly short-answer summarization (avg 120 tokens input, 80 tokens output), repeated across ~3,000 student submissions over two weeks. Estimated peak concurrency is low but sustained.

We appreciate any assistance — even a partial top-up would keep the pilot going and help us deliver metrics for the larger grant proposal.

Warmly,
Leila Ahmad
Principal Investigator, StudyHub Research Collective
l.ahmad@studyhub.org
Attachment: IRB-consent.pdf, pilot-impact-summary.pdf
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Dr. Leila Ahmad <l.ahmad@studyhub.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request

Hi Leila — thanks for the context and the attachments, really helpful detail.

Quick note while I loop in a couple of folks on our side: Monica (promo & credits) — can you review whether we can provide a trial top-up and for how much? Jonas (security) — could you quick-check the IRB extract and confirm any constraints we should note for hosted usage?

My first-pass proposal (provisional) is: approve a 15k token promotional supplement + a one-week trial extension while we confirm details. If Monica can confirm a larger supplement, we can escalate.

Leila — two quick questions that will speed approvals:
- Can you confirm whether any student PII is included in the prompts (names, IDs)?
- Do you expect the workload to continue after this cohort (i.e., will usage spike again)?

If you prefer a phone call, I have a 30-minute slot tomorrow at 10:30am PST.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-18T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request

Hey both — reviewed the attachments and the requested uplift. Given StudyHub's non-profit/academic status and the clear, time-limited ask, I can approve a promotional credit of 15,000 token-equivalent and a 7-day trial extension today. Please note internal tagging rules: mark as PROMO-EDU-2027 when you apply. Finance will need the stub noted in the account.

I cannot commit the full 30k without escalation to head of growth, but we can offer a supplemental review next week (Mon/Tue) if Leila confirms continued need.

Attaching a one-line approval stub for the ledger.

Attachment: promo-approval-stub.txt
Monica Patel
Credit Ops, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-19T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request

Quick security note: IRB excerpt looks fine. Leila — to proceed on hosted trial we need confirmation that prompts/payloads are pseudonymized and do not include direct identifiers (student name + government ID). If any PII is present, we should either remove it or switch to our Private deployment checklist (short lead time) prior to processing.

If StudyHub prefers to stay hosted with pseudonymization steps, send over a short note confirming that policy and we can proceed.

Also, for our audit logs we need the expected start/end dates for the top-up window.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Dr. Leila Ahmad <l.ahmad@studyhub.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-19T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request

Hi Leila — good news: we can provisionally apply 15,000 token-equivalent promotional credits and extend your trial window by 7 days. Conditions and next steps below:

1) Security: please reply confirming that the prompts will be pseudonymized (no direct student identifiers). If you are already redacting in your ingestion pipeline, a one-line confirmation is sufficient.
2) Activation: once you confirm, Monica will apply the PROMO-EDU-2027 tag and the credits will show in your account. I attached the short promo terms and activation steps for reference.
3) Timeline: credits will cover activity through 2027-02-26 (inclusive). If you still need additional support after that date, we can request a supplemental review next week (Mon/Tue).
4) Billing/notes: this will be logged as a promotional credit and will not generate an invoice. If you need a formal memo for your grant office, we can produce a short MOU.

Attachments: promo-terms.pdf, activation-instructions.txt

Would you like me to schedule the 10:30am PST call tomorrow to walk through activation?

Best,
Tessa
From: Dr. Leila Ahmad <l.ahmad@studyhub.org>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StudyHub pilot — compute/top-up request

Hi Tessa / Monica / Jonas — thank you all, this is fantastic and will keep the pilot running.

Confirming: we pseudonymize at ingestion and do not include student names or government IDs in the prompts. We accept the 15k credit and the 7-day window through 2027-02-26. Please go ahead and apply the PROMO-EDU-2027 tag; a short MOU would be helpful for our internal grant tracker.

I can also join the 10:30am PST call tomorrow — please send a calendar invite if that works.

Much appreciated,
Leila
